method_freeze.constructor: g2_anyio_mutable_closure_equivalence_fix_v2.py repair derivation logic exact inherited semantics
method_freeze.selector: equivalence class over byte-identical first-eight policy candidate IDs; names have no authority

metadata_query.inspect: PR metadata plus changed filenames only; do not fetch patches, bodies into experiment logic, source blobs, author tests, CI outcomes, issue comments or repaired production before role freeze
eligibility: exactly one changed .py path outside tests/, test/, docs/, examples/, benchmarks/ and not named test_*.py
at least one changed .py test path under tests/ or test/ or basename beginning test_
base and head full SHAs present
metadata_query.tie_break: first eligible PR in returned search order for each repository; then first two eligible repositories in repository_universe order become TRAINING and HELDOUT_FUTURE

source_admission.after_role_freeze: Fetch only exact TRAINING base plus exact changed author-test blobs from its head; repaired production head remains unread. FUTURE source/test bodies remain unopened until TRAINING method either qualifies or stops.
source_admission.original_failure: Original base + exact author-test overlay must produce nonempty native pytest execution with at least one author-protected failure and zero collection/setup apparatus errors outside the protected test result.
source_admission.test_scope: changed author-test file(s) only for admission; full upstream suite is not required at initial failure gate
source_admission.source_integrity: exact Git commit/tree/blob binding and clean worktree except declared author-test overlay

prospective_training.observer: unchanged source-neutral persistent nested-closure detector/observer from parent
prospective_training.candidate: unchanged deterministic five-line unwrap/rebind repair constructor, one candidate per detected pattern in source order
prospective_training.pass: native TRAINING repair passes changed author test file twice, withdrawal restores protected failure, restoration re-passes
prospective_training.stop: if no pattern, no native stale persistence, no generated repair, apparatus UNKNOWN, or repair fails -> STOP; FUTURE remains unopened

heldout_future.open_condition: only after TRAINING repair and class selector qualify under this frozen protocol
heldout_future.pass: same unchanged observer/constructor/selector generates a FUTURE repair from future source-native evidence; native author-test PASS, withdrawal failure, restoration PASS
heldout_future.G2_promotion: WARRANTED_BOUNDED_PROSPECTIVE_G2 only if TRAINING and FUTURE both satisfy causal gates and FUTURE source was unopened before TRAINING qualification
heldout_future.comparator_requirement: run equally informed direct source-pattern baseline and executable-ledger replay baseline on FUTURE; report acquisition, native verification and restart cost

boundaries.source_unfamiliarity: bounded to absence from declared prior ROS task repositories and no source body access in this experiment before freeze; model pretraining/global familiarity UNKNOWN
